• Wertschätzung & Teamkultur: Bei uns bist du Teil eines starken und inklusiven Teams, das zusammenhält, Ideen teilt und Herausforderungen gemeinsam meistert. Eine vertrauensvolle Führungskultur sorgt dafür, dass dein Engagement gesehen und geschätzt wird.

• Flexibiliät & Work-Life-Balance: Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung, 41 Stundenwoche, Teilzeitmöglichkeiten, 25-30 Tage Ferien, Ferienkauf, verlängerter Mutter- und Vaterschaftsurlaub

• Attraktive Vergütung: Wir bieten unseren MItarbeitenden ein attraktives Vergütungspaket mit vielen Zusatzleistungen und einer sehr guten Pensionskasse

• Mitarbeitervorteile: Von Reka-Checks über Aktien zum Vorzugspreis bis hin zur Swibeco-Vorteilswelt - wir sorgen dafür, dass du dich rundum wohlfühlst und von attraktiven Zusatzleistungen profitierst

• Attractive compensation: We offer our employees an attractive compensation package with many additional benefits and a very good pension fund

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a doer? Are you tackling problems and looking for new solutions? As a committed and resilient person, you have the opportunity to take on crucial tasks and thus contribute significantly to the smooth operation of our plants and processes. Become part of our team at the cement plant in Untervaz and shape the future with us!

What to expect:

• You lead and motivate your shift team and work with them to ensure that our production goals are achieved safely and successfully.

• You coordinate the operational planning, keep an eye on the processes and ensure smooth operation.

• You control and monitor our production – from raw material processing to cement production – and ensure the highest safety and quality standards.

• Together with various specialist areas, you will continuously develop our processes and actively contribute to the optimization of our production

What you bring:

• You are enthusiastic about technology and understand how to grasp and implement technical connections

• You have a technical or manual vocational training (plant manager of advantage)

• Ideally, you have a further education as an industry master

• Strong PC knowledge and a good technical understanding are no problem for you

• Experience in team leadership, excellent communication skills is your most valuable strength

• You find solutions to problems, enjoy working in a team and bring in new ideas

• You are physically fit and ready for shift work

Our offer:

• Onboarding & getting started: Look forward to a team-oriented, open and future-oriented working environment. We accompany you from the beginning with a careful training, practical and structured, so that you can start successfully.

• Career & Development: We create opportunities. With us, you are at the center as a person with your individual strengths and potential. Anyone who wants to is supported by us and can achieve a lot.

• Appreciation & Team Culture: With us, you are part of a strong and inclusive team that holds together, shares ideas and masters challenges together. A trusting leadership culture ensures that your commitment is seen and appreciated.

• Flexibility & Work-Life-Balance: We offer flexible working hours, 41 hours, part-time opportunities, 25-30 days holidays, holiday purchase, extended maternity and paternity leave

• Attractive compensation: We offer our employees an attractive compensation package with many additional benefits and a very good pension fund

• Employee benefits: From Reka checks to shares at a preferential price to the Swibeco advantage world - we make sure that you feel comfortable and benefit from attractive additional services

jobs.title: H&S Koordinator:in Kies & Beton 80-100%

titleByLocale.fr: Coordonnateur de la santé et de la sécurité : à Kies & Beton 80-100 %

jobs.description:
Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir eine zuverlässige, motivierte und engagierte Persönlichkeit, um weiterhin unseren hohen Qualitätsanspruch zu gewährleisten.

Was dich erwartet:

•
 Du coachst und unterstützt unsere Linienvorgesetzten, Mitarbeitenden und Projektleiter in der Region Zentralschweiz und Nordostschweiz bei allen fachspezifischen H&S-Fragen und der Umsetzung von Massnahmen

•
 Du bist regelmässig vor Ort, tauschst dich mit den Werksleitern aus und hast ein offenes Ohr für unsere Mitarbeitenden „im Feld“

•
 Gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen an den Standorten führst du Gefährdungsbeurteilungen durch und sorgst so für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld

•
 Du entwickelst, planst und koordinierst Aktionen sowie Ausbildungen, um unsere Sicherheitskultur nachhaltig zu stärken und weiterzuentwickeln

•
 Du prüfst, ob unsere Konzernvorgaben, Prozesse und die nationalen Anforderungen (z. B. der SUVA) an Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz aktuell sind und konsequent umgesetzt werden

•
 Bei Ereignissen oder Unfällen gehst du den Dingen auf den Grund, identifizierst die Ursachen und erarbeitest im Team Korrekturmassnahmen. Die Ergebnisse reportest du anschliessend in unserem Konzern-Tool

•
 Du arbeitest aktiv an der Bewirtschaftung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Managementsysteme (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001) im Bereich Kies und Beton mit

• Du bringst dein Fachwissen in Arbeitsgruppen auf CEW-Stufe ein und pflegst den Kontakt zu Branchenverbänden und Behörden

Was du mitbringst:

•
 Du hast eine Technische Ausbildung (HF, FH, ETH) und Erfahrung in der Schwerindustrie

•
 Du bist EKAS Sicherheitsfachmann, Sicherheitsingenieur oder ähnlich inkl. einer obligatorischen Fortbildung

•
 Du hast bereits Erfahrung in einer leitenden Funktion gesammelt und weisst, wie man Teams motiviert und Verantwortung übernimmt

•
 Du kennst dich in der Baustoffindustrie oder einem vergleichbaren industriellen Produktionsumfeld bestens aus und fühlst dich zwischen Kieswerk und Betonmischanlage wohl

•
 Du besitzt ein tiefes Verständnis für spezifische Betriebsrisiken und erkennst instinktiv, wo wir ansetzen müssen, um die Sicherheit zu erhöhen

•
 Die gesetzlichen Vorschriften und Normen (Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheitsschutz, Umweltvorgaben) sind dein tägliches Handwerkszeug. Mit den gängigen ISO-Standards (9001, 14001, 45001/OHSAS 18001) bist du bestens vertraut

• Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Projekten mit – du konzipierst nicht nur gern, sondern begleitest Massnahmen auch bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss

descriptionByLocale.it:

Cosa aspettarsi:

Potrai allenare e sostenere i nostri direttori di linea, dipendenti e project manager nella regione della Svizzera Centrale e Nord-Est in tutte le questioni specifiche H&S e l'attuazione delle misure

Siete regolarmente in loco, scambiate idee con i gestori degli impianti e avete un orecchio aperto per i nostri dipendenti “in campo”.

Insieme a coloro che sono responsabili nei luoghi, si effettuano valutazioni dei rischi e quindi garantire un ambiente di lavoro sicuro

Si sviluppa, progetta e coordina azioni e formazione per rafforzare e sviluppare in modo sostenibile la nostra cultura della sicurezza

•
Verifica se le specifiche del nostro Gruppo, i processi e i requisiti nazionali (ad es. SUVA) per la sicurezza e la tutela della salute sul lavoro sono aggiornati e costantemente implementati

•
In caso di eventi o incidenti, si arriva al fondo delle cose, identificare le cause e elaborare misure correttive nel team. Poi report i risultati nel nostro strumento Gruppo

•
Sei attivamente coinvolto nella gestione e nello sviluppo dei nostri sistemi di gestione (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001) nel campo della ghiaia e del cemento

• Porti la tua esperienza a gruppi di lavoro a livello CEW e mantieni il contatto con associazioni e autorità del settore

Cosa porti:

•
Hai una formazione tecnica (HF, FH, ETH) e l'esperienza nell'industria pesante

•
Lei è uno specialista di sicurezza EKAS, ingegnere di sicurezza o simile incl. Formazione obbligatoria

•
Hai già esperienza in un ruolo senior e sai come motivare i team e assumersi la responsabilità

•
Hai familiarità con l'industria dei materiali da costruzione o con un ambiente di produzione industriale paragonabile e ti senti a tuo agio tra impianto di miscelazione ghiaia e cemento

•
Hai una profonda comprensione dei rischi operativi specifici e istintivamente vedere dove dobbiamo iniziare ad aumentare la sicurezza

•
Le normative e gli standard legali (sicurezza del lavoro, protezione della salute, requisiti ambientali) sono i vostri strumenti quotidiani. Hai molto familiarità con gli standard ISO attuali (9001, 14001, 45001/OHSAS 18001)

• Porti l'esperienza pratica nell'attuazione dei progetti – non solo ti piace progettare, ma anche accompagnare misure fino al completamento di successo
descriptionByLocale.en:
To support our team, we are looking for a reliable, motivated and committed personality to continue to ensure our high quality standards.

What to expect:

•
You will coach and support our line managers, employees and project managers in the Central and Northeast Switzerland region in all subject-specific H&S questions and the implementation of measures

•
You are regularly on site, exchange ideas with the plant managers and have an open ear for our employees “in the field”.

•
Together with those responsible at the locations, you carry out risk assessments and thus ensure a safe working environment

•
You develop, plan and coordinate actions and training to sustainably strengthen and develop our safety culture

•
You check whether our Group specifications, processes and national requirements (e.g. SUVA) for occupational safety and health protection are up-to-date and consistently implemented

•
In the event of events or accidents, you get to the bottom of things, identify the causes and work out corrective measures in the team. You then report the results in our Group tool

•
You are actively involved in the management and further development of our management systems (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001) in the field of gravel and concrete

• You bring your expertise to work groups at CEW level and maintain contact with industry associations and authorities

What you bring:

•
You have a technical education (HF, FH, ETH) and experience in heavy industry

•
You are an EKAS security specialist, security engineer or similar incl. compulsory training

•
You already have experience in a senior role and know how to motivate teams and take responsibility

•
You are familiar with the building materials industry or a comparable industrial production environment and feel comfortable between gravel and concrete mixing plant

•
You have a deep understanding of specific operational risks and instinctively see where we need to start to increase safety

•
The legal regulations and standards (work safety, health protection, environmental requirements) are your daily tools. You are very familiar with the current ISO standards (9001, 14001, 45001/OHSAS 18001)

• You bring practical experience in the implementation of projects – you not only like to design, but also accompany measures until successful completion

jobs.title: Head of Logistics - Central Eastern Europe (CEE)

titleByLocale.en: Head of Logistics - Central Eastern Europe (CEE)

jobs.description:
At Holcim, we believe logistics has the potential to be far more than an operational function. Connecting our plants, customers, suppliers and markets, logistics is a critical lever for improving competitiveness, enhancing customer experience and creating long-term business value.

As Head of Logistics – Central Eastern Europe (CEE) , you will lead the transformation of our regional logistics organization. Building on our decentralized operating model, you will introduce a more systematic, standardized and performance-driven approach while preserving the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of our local businesses.

Working closely with country leadership teams, Group Logistics and cross-functional partners, you will define and execute the regional logistics strategy, strengthen governance, accelerate digitalization, optimize transport and distribution networks, and embed best practices that improve service, efficiency, sustainability and operational excellence. Through this transformation, you will help position logistics as a true business enabler, creating measurable value for our customers and the wider business.

Key Responsibilities

•
 Define and execute the regional logistics strategy across Central Eastern Europe.

•
 Design, implement and continuously improve the regional logistics operating model, ensuring standardized processes, governance and best practices while supporting local execution.

•
 Lead transportation, warehousing, distribution, dispatching and customer service excellence initiatives to improve operational efficiency, service reliability and customer experience.

•
 Drive disciplined logistics cost management by identifying efficiency opportunities, optimizing network design and improving productivity while maintaining high service levels.

•
 Lead the adoption of digital logistics solutions, advanced analytics and automation to improve visibility, planning, decision-making and operational performance.

•
 Drive performance through key logistics KPIs, including service reliability, transport productivity, asset utilization, safety and cost-to-serve, ensuring data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.

•
 Build and maintain strategic relationships with logistics providers and key internal and external stakeholders.

•
 Strengthen logistics governance while ensuring compliance with health, safety, regulatory and sustainability standards and proactively managing operational risks and business continuity.

•
 Lead cross-functional collaboration with procurement, manufacturing, commercial, customer excellence, finance and supply chain teams.

•
 Develop high-performing logistics teams by investing in capability building, leadership development, succession planning and knowledge sharing.

•
 Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.

•
 Support decarbonization initiatives through more sustainable transport solutions and network optimization.

What We Are Looking For

•
 University degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Procurement, Business Administration or a related discipline.

•
 10+ years of progressive experience in logistics or supply chain leadership, ideally within an industrial or manufacturing environment.

•
 Proven experience leading regional, multi-site or cross-country operations and driving business transformation.

•
 Strong understanding of transport networks, warehousing, distribution, dispatching, logistics performance management and cost optimization.

•
 Experience with digital logistics solutions, analytics and continuous improvement methodologies is highly desirable.

•
 Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions, countries and cultures.

•
 Strategic mindset combined with strong operational and execution capabilities.

•
 Proven leadership skills with the ability to develop teams, lead through influence and drive change in a decentralized environment.

•
 Resilient, customer-focused and committed to operational excellence and continuous improvement.

•
 Fluent in English; additional European languages are an advantage.

•
 Willingness to travel regularly within the region.

What We Offer

•
 A high-impact regional leadership role with the opportunity to shape the future of logistics across Central Eastern Europe.

•
 The opportunity to transform logistics into a strategic business enabler that creates measurable value for customers and the business.

•
 Exposure to senior stakeholders across countries, functions and Group Logistics.

•
 The opportunity to lead transformation in digitalization, network optimization, operational excellence, cost efficiency and sustainability.

•
 An international, collaborative environment where innovation, continuous improvement and leadership are valued.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Holcim, crediamo che la logistica abbia il potenziale di essere molto più di una funzione operativa. Collegare i nostri impianti, clienti, fornitori e mercati, la logistica è una leva fondamentale per migliorare la competitività, migliorare l'esperienza del cliente e creare valore aziendale a lungo termine.

Come Capo della Logistica – Europa centrale orientale (CEE) , guiderete la trasformazione della nostra organizzazione logistica regionale. Basandosi sul nostro modello operativo decentralizzato, si introdurrà un approccio più sistematico, standardizzato e orientato alle prestazioni, preservando l'agilità e lo spirito imprenditoriale delle nostre aziende locali.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di leadership del paese, Group Logistics e partner interfunzionali, definire ed eseguire la strategia logistica regionale, rafforzare la governance, accelerare la digitalizzazione, ottimizzare le reti di trasporto e distribuzione, e incorporare le migliori pratiche che migliorano il servizio, l'efficienza, la sostenibilità e l'eccellenza operativa. Attraverso questa trasformazione, aiuterai a posizionare la logistica come un vero e proprio attivatore aziendale, creando un valore misurabile per i nostri clienti e per il business più ampio.

Principali responsabilità

•
Definire ed eseguire la strategia logistica regionale in tutta l'Europa centroorientale.

•
Progettare, implementare e migliorare continuamente il modello operativo della logistica regionale, garantendo processi standardizzati, governance e best practice, supportando l'esecuzione locale.

•
Iniziative di eccellenza per il trasporto, lo stoccaggio, la distribuzione, l'invio e il servizio clienti per migliorare l'efficienza operativa, l'affidabilità del servizio e l'esperienza del cliente.

•
Guidare la gestione dei costi logistica disciplinata individuando opportunità di efficienza, ottimizzando la progettazione della rete e migliorando la produttività mantenendo alti livelli di servizio.

•
Condurre l'adozione di soluzioni logistiche digitali, analisi e automazione avanzate per migliorare la visibilità, la pianificazione, il processo decisionale e le prestazioni operative.

•
Prestazioni di trasmissione attraverso i KPI di logistica chiave, tra cui affidabilità dei servizi, produttività dei trasporti, utilizzo degli asset, sicurezza e costi-to-serve, assicurando il processo decisionale e il miglioramento continuo.

•
Costruire e mantenere relazioni strategiche con i fornitori di logistica e le principali parti interessate interne ed esterne.

•
Rafforzare la governance logistica garantendo nel contempo il rispetto degli standard di salute, sicurezza, regolamentazione e sostenibilità e la gestione proattiva dei rischi operativi e della continuità aziendale.

•
Leader collaborazione interfunzionale con i team di approvvigionamento, produzione, commerciale, eccellenza del cliente, finanza e supply chain.

•
Sviluppare team logistici altamente performanti investendo nella costruzione di capacità, sviluppo di leadership, pianificazione di successione e condivisione di conoscenze.

•
Promuovere una cultura di eccellenza operativa, responsabilità, innovazione e miglioramento continuo.

•
Sostenere le iniziative di decarbonizzazione attraverso soluzioni di trasporto più sostenibili e ottimizzazione della rete.

Cosa stiamo cercando

•
Laurea in Supply Chain, Logistica, Ingegneria, appalti, Business Administration o una disciplina relativa.

•
10+ anni di esperienza progressiva nella logistica o nella leadership della supply chain, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente industriale o produttivo.

•
Esperienza comprovata che conduce le operazioni regionali, multi-sito o cross-country e la trasformazione aziendale di guida.

•
Forte comprensione delle reti di trasporto, stoccaggio, distribuzione, spedizione, gestione delle prestazioni logistiche e ottimizzazione dei costi.

•
L'esperienza con soluzioni logistiche digitali, metodologie di analisi e miglioramento continuo è altamente auspicabile.

Ottima gestione degli stakeholder e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente in funzioni, paesi e culture.

Mindset strategico combinato con forti capacità operative e di esecuzione.

Prove capacità di leadership con la capacità di sviluppare team, condurre attraverso l'influenza e guidare il cambiamento in un ambiente decentralizzato.

•
Resiliente, orientato al cliente e impegnato per eccellenza operativa e miglioramento continuo.

•
Fluente in inglese; lingue europee aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

Volontà di viaggiare regolarmente all'interno della regione.

Cosa offriamo

Un ruolo di leadership regionale ad alto impatto con l'opportunità di plasmare il futuro della logistica in tutta l'Europa centroorientale.

•
L'opportunità di trasformare la logistica in un'impresa strategica che crea un valore misurabile per i clienti e il business.

•
Esposizione agli stakeholder senior in tutti i paesi, funzioni e Group Logistics.

•
L'opportunità di condurre la trasformazione in digitalizzazione, ottimizzazione della rete, eccellenza operativa, efficienza dei costi e sostenibilità.

Un ambiente internazionale e collaborativo dove innovazione, miglioramento continuo e leadership sono valutati.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Holcim, we believe logistics has the potential to be far more than an operational function. Connecting our plants, customers, suppliers and markets, logistics is a critical lever for improving competitiveness, enhancing customer experience and creating long-term business value.

As Head of Logistics – Central Eastern Europe (CEE) , you will lead the transformation of our regional logistics organization. Building on our decentralized operating model, you will introduce a more systematic, standardized and performance-driven approach while preserving the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of our local businesses.

Working closely with country leadership teams, Group Logistics and cross-functional partners, you will define and execute the regional logistics strategy, strengthen governance, accelerate digitalization, optimize transport and distribution networks, and embed best practices that improve service, efficiency, sustainability and operational excellence. Through this transformation, you will help position logistics as a true business enabler, creating measurable value for our customers and the wider business.

Key Responsibilities

•
Define and execute the regional logistics strategy across Central Eastern Europe.

•
Design, implement and continuously improve the regional logistics operating model, ensuring standardized processes, governance and best practices while supporting local execution.

•
Lead transportation, warehousing, distribution, dispatching and customer service excellence initiatives to improve operational efficiency, service reliability and customer experience.

•
Drive disciplined logistics cost management by identifying efficiency opportunities, optimizing network design and improving productivity while maintaining high service levels.

•
Lead the adoption of digital logistics solutions, advanced analytics and automation to improve visibility, planning, decision-making and operational performance.

•
Drive performance through key logistics KPIs, including service reliability, transport productivity, asset utilization, safety and cost-to-serve, ensuring data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.

•
Build and maintain strategic relationships with logistics providers and key internal and external stakeholders.

•
Strengthen logistics governance while ensuring compliance with health, safety, regulatory and sustainability standards and proactively managing operational risks and business continuity.

•
Lead cross-functional collaboration with procurement, manufacturing, commercial, customer excellence, finance and supply chain teams.

•
Develop high-performing logistics teams by investing in capability building, leadership development, succession planning and knowledge sharing.

•
Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.

•
Support decarbonization initiatives through more sustainable transport solutions and network optimization.

What We Are Looking For

•
University degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Procurement, Business Administration or a related discipline.

•
10+ years of progressive experience in logistics or supply chain leadership, ideally within an industrial or manufacturing environment.

•
Proven experience leading regional, multi-site or cross-country operations and driving business transformation.

•
Strong understanding of transport networks, warehousing, distribution, dispatching, logistics performance management and cost optimization.

•
Experience with digital logistics solutions, analytics and continuous improvement methodologies is highly desirable.

•
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions, countries and cultures.

•
Strategic mindset combined with strong operational and execution capabilities.

•
Proven leadership skills with the ability to develop teams, lead through influence and drive change in a decentralized environment.

•
Resilient, customer-focused and committed to operational excellence and continuous improvement.

•
Fluent in English; additional European languages are an advantage.

•
Willingness to travel regularly within the region.

What We Offer

•
A high-impact regional leadership role with the opportunity to shape the future of logistics across Central Eastern Europe.

•
The opportunity to transform logistics into a strategic business enabler that creates measurable value for customers and the business.

•
Exposure to senior stakeholders across countries, functions and Group Logistics.

•
The opportunity to lead transformation in digitalization, network optimization, operational excellence, cost efficiency and sustainability.

•
An international, collaborative environment where innovation, continuous improvement and leadership are valued.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Holcim glauben wir, dass Logistik das Potenzial hat, weit mehr als eine operative Funktion zu sein. Durch die Verbindung unserer Werke, Kunden, Lieferanten und Märkte ist die Logistik ein entscheidender Hebel, um die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu verbessern, das Kundenerlebnis zu verbessern und langfristigen Geschäftswert zu schaffen.

Als Head of Logistics – Central Eastern Europe (CEE) leiten Sie die Transformation unserer regionalen Logistikorganisation. Aufbauend auf unserem dezentralen Betriebsmodell werden Sie einen systematischeren, standardisierteren und leistungsorientierten Ansatz einführen und gleichzeitig die Agilität und den Unternehmergeist unserer lokalen Unternehmen bewahren.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Länderführungsteams, Group Logistics und funktionsübergreifenden Partnern definieren und implementieren Sie die regionale Logistikstrategie, stärken die Governance, beschleunigen die Digitalisierung, optimieren Transport- und Vertriebsnetze und integrieren Best Practices, die Service, Effizienz, Nachhaltigkeit und operative Exzellenz verbessern. Durch diese Transformation werden Sie dazu beitragen, die Logistik als echten Business Enabler zu positionieren und einen messbaren Wert für unsere Kunden und das gesamte Geschäft zu schaffen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

•
Definition und Umsetzung der regionalen Logistikstrategie in Mittelosteuropa.

•
Design, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung des regionalen Logistikbetriebsmodells, um standardisierte Prozesse, Governance und Best Practices zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die lokale Umsetzung zu unterstützen.

•
Führen Sie Transport-, Lager-, Vertriebs-, Versand- und Kundenservice-Exzellenzinitiativen, um die betriebliche Effizienz, die Servicezuverlässigkeit und die Kundenerfahrung zu verbessern.

•
Fördern Sie ein diszipliniertes Logistikkostenmanagement, indem Sie Effizienzmöglichkeiten identifizieren, das Netzwerkdesign optimieren und die Produktivität verbessern und gleichzeitig ein hohes Serviceniveau beibehalten.

•
Führen Sie die Einführung digitaler Logistiklösungen, fortschrittlicher Analysen und Automatisierung, um Sichtbarkeit, Planung, Entscheidungsfindung und operative Leistung zu verbessern.

•
Steigern Sie die Leistung durch wichtige Logistik-KPIs, einschließlich Servicezuverlässigkeit, Transportproduktivität, Anlagenauslastung, Sicherheit und Kosten-zu-Service, um datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu gewährleisten.

•
Aufbau und Pflege strategischer Beziehungen zu Logistikanbietern und wichtigen internen und externen Stakeholdern.

•
Stärkung der Logistik-Governance bei gleichzeitiger Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Gesundheits-, Sicherheits-, Regulierungs- und Nachhaltigkeitsstandards und proaktivem Management von Betriebsrisiken und Geschäftskontinuität.

•
Führen Sie die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit Beschaffungs-, Fertigungs-, Handels-, Kundenexzellenz-, Finanz- und Lieferkettenteams.

•
Entwickeln Sie leistungsstarke Logistikteams, indem Sie in den Aufbau von Fähigkeiten, die Entwicklung von Führungskräften, die Nachfolgeplanung und den Wissensaustausch investieren.

•
Förderung einer Kultur der operativen Exzellenz, Rechenschaftspflicht, Innovation und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

•
Unterstützung von Dekarbonisierungsinitiativen durch nachhaltigere Transportlösungen und Netzwerkoptimierung.

Was wir suchen

•
Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Logistik, Engineering, Beschaffung, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

•
10+ Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Logistik oder Supply Chain Leadership, idealerweise in einem Industrie- oder Fertigungsumfeld.

•
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung regionaler, standortübergreifender oder länderübergreifender Operationen und der Förderung der Geschäftstransformation.

•
Ein fundiertes Verständnis von Transportnetzwerken, Lagerhaltung, Verteilung, Versand, Logistik-Leistungsmanagement und Kostenoptimierung.

•
Erfahrung mit digitalen Logistiklösungen, Analysen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden ist sehr wünschenswert.

•
Hervorragendes Stakeholder-Management und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv über Funktionen, Länder und Kulturen hinweg zusammenzuarbeiten.

•
Strategische Denkweise kombiniert mit starken operativen und ausführenden Fähigkeiten.

•
Bewährte Führungsqualitäten mit der Fähigkeit, Teams zu entwickeln, durch Einfluss zu führen und Veränderungen in einer dezentralen Umgebung voranzutreiben.

•
Resilient, kundenorientiert und engagiert für operative Exzellenz und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

•
Fließend Englisch; zusätzliche europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

•
Bereitschaft, regelmäßig innerhalb der Region zu reisen.

Was wir anbieten

•
Eine einflussreiche regionale Führungsrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Zukunft der Logistik in Mittelosteuropa zu gestalten.

•
Die Möglichkeit, die Logistik in einen strategischen Business Enabler zu verwandeln, der messbaren Wert für Kunden und das Geschäft schafft.

•
Exposition gegenüber leitenden Stakeholdern in allen Ländern, Funktionen und Gruppenlogistik.

•
Die Chance, die Transformation in den Bereichen Digitalisierung, Netzwerkoptimierung, operative Exzellenz, Kosteneffizienz und Nachhaltigkeit anzuführen.

•
Ein internationales, kollaboratives Umfeld, in dem Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Führung geschätzt werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À Holcim, nous croyons que la logistique peut être bien plus qu'une fonction opérationnelle. Connecter nos usines, nos clients, nos fournisseurs et nos marchés, la logistique est un levier essentiel pour améliorer la compétitivité, améliorer l'expérience client et créer une valeur commerciale à long terme.

En tant que Chef de la logistique – Europe Centrale de l'Est (CEE), vous dirigerez la transformation de notre organisation logistique régionale. En s'appuyant sur notre modèle opérationnel décentralisé, vous adopterez une approche plus systématique, normalisée et axée sur la performance tout en préservant l'agilité et l'esprit d'entreprise de nos entreprises locales.

En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de leadership de pays, le Groupe Logistique et les partenaires interfonctionnels, vous définirez et exécuterez la stratégie logistique régionale, renforcerez la gouvernance, accélérerez la numérisation, optimiserez les réseaux de transport et de distribution et intégrerez les meilleures pratiques qui améliorent le service, l'efficacité, la durabilité et l'excellence opérationnelle. Grâce à cette transformation, vous aiderez à positionner la logistique comme un véritable moteur d'affaires, créant une valeur mesurable pour nos clients et l'ensemble des entreprises.

Principales responsabilités

•
Définir et exécuter la stratégie logistique régionale dans toute l'Europe centrale de l'Est.

•
Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et améliorer en permanence le modèle opérationnel de la logistique régionale, en veillant à uniformiser les processus, la gouvernance et les meilleures pratiques tout en appuyant l'exécution locale.

•
Des initiatives d'excellence en matière de transport, d'entreposage, de distribution, d'expédition et de service à la clientèle pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, la fiabilité du service et l'expérience client.

•
Diriger la gestion des coûts de logistique disciplinée en identifiant les possibilités d'efficacité, en optimisant la conception du réseau et en améliorant la productivité tout en maintenant des niveaux de service élevés.

•
Diriger l'adoption de solutions logistiques numériques, d'analyses avancées et d'automatisation pour améliorer la visibilité, la planification, la prise de décisions et la performance opérationnelle.

•
Diriger les performances à travers des ICR logistiques clés, y compris la fiabilité des services, la productivité du transport, l'utilisation des actifs, la sécurité et le coût-à-server, en assurant la prise de décision axée sur les données et l'amélioration continue.

•
Établir et maintenir des relations stratégiques avec les fournisseurs de services logistiques et les principaux intervenants internes et externes.

•
Renforcer la gouvernance logistique tout en assurant le respect des normes en matière de santé, de sécurité, de réglementation et de durabilité et en gérant de façon proactive les risques opérationnels et la continuité des activités.

•
Diriger la collaboration interfonctionnelle avec les équipes d'approvisionnement, de fabrication, commerciale, d'excellence client, de finance et de chaîne d'approvisionnement.

•
Développer des équipes logistiques performantes en investissant dans le renforcement des capacités, le développement du leadership, la planification de la relève et le partage des connaissances.

•
Favoriser une culture d'excellence opérationnelle, de responsabilisation, d'innovation et d'amélioration continue.

•
Soutenir les initiatives de décarbonisation par des solutions de transport plus durables et l'optimisation des réseaux.

Ce que nous cherchons

•
Diplôme universitaire en chaîne d'approvisionnement, logistique, génie, approvisionnement, administration des affaires ou une discipline connexe.

•
10+ ans d'expérience progressive en logistique ou en leadership de chaîne d'approvisionnement, idéalement dans un environnement industriel ou manufacturier.

•
Expérience éprouvée menant des opérations régionales, multi-sites ou cross-country et conduisant à la transformation des affaires.

•
Une bonne compréhension des réseaux de transport, l'entreposage, la distribution, l'expédition, la gestion de la performance logistique et l'optimisation des coûts.

•
L'expérience des solutions logistiques numériques, des méthodes d'analyse et d'amélioration continue est hautement souhaitable.

•
Excellente gestion des parties prenantes et influence les compétences, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement entre les fonctions, les pays et les cultures.

•
Un état d'esprit stratégique associé à de solides capacités opérationnelles et d'exécution.

•
Compétences éprouvées en leadership avec la capacité de développer des équipes, de diriger par influence et de stimuler le changement dans un environnement décentralisé.

•
Résilient, axé sur le client et attaché à l'excellence opérationnelle et à l'amélioration continue.

•
La maîtrise de l'anglais; d'autres langues européennes sont un avantage.

•
Volonté de voyager régulièrement dans la région.

Ce que nous offrons

•
Un rôle de chef de file régional à fort impact avec la possibilité de façonner l'avenir de la logistique dans toute l'Europe centrale de l'Est.

•
La possibilité de transformer la logistique en un catalyseur stratégique qui crée une valeur mesurable pour les clients et l'entreprise.

•
Exposition à des intervenants de haut niveau dans tous les pays, fonctions et logistique de groupe.

•
L'occasion de diriger la transformation en digitalisation, optimisation des réseaux, excellence opérationnelle, rentabilité et durabilité.

•
Un environnement international et collaboratif où l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et le leadership sont valorisés.

jobs.title: Innovation Process Engineer Thermal
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Holcim announced in 2025 the NextGen Growth 2030 strategy with the vision to be the leading partner for sustainable construction and creating superior value for people, customers and shareholders. The main four pillars of the strategy are focused investment in attractive markets, sustainability driving profitable growth, expanding high-value building solutions as well as a performance culture and value creation. Part of the sustainability targets are tripling volumes of recycled material base 2024 (20+Mt of construction demolition material), reducing scope emissions below 400 kg/t cementitious as well as reducing 33% of freshwater withdrawal. We have to further develop various technologies with

the objective of having 2030 economically viable solutions at industrial scale and producing low/no CO2 products. In order

to develop and manage disruptive technologies and give best support to the countries in integrating new technologies in

the cement manufacturing environment, technical activities need to be coordinated amongst various players.

Main responsibilities

• Developing or scouting disruptive ideas and concepts in the field of cement manufacturing with a focus on thermal process technologies, combustion and energy management; mainly open innovation, partially own development.

• Designing thermal processes from ideas via lab testing to successful commissioning of demonstrators

• Developing, implementing and driving tests, prototypes and pilot plants together with Group companies

• Coordination of various stakeholders and partners at global level in the field of process innovation projects, internal as well as external (academia, suppliers etc) while also ensuring interface to upstream and downstream processes

• Developing future knowledge for the Holcim group

• Coaching and empowering project teams in the countries and regions in order to drive process innovation within their projects or studies.

• Represent the Process Innovation team in different Holcim projects, in meetings and/or conferences, share, spread out knowledge and best practices

Profile required

1 - Technical / functional skills:

• Technical leadership in traditional and alternative combustion technologies, understanding mineralogical clinker phases is an asset

• Experience working in a multicultural and multidisciplinary environments

• Experience in an innovation environment is an asset

2 - Leadership and managerial abilities:

• Leading for results without being in charge

• Challenging the status quo

• Team orientation

• Performance orientation

3 - Behavioural competencies:

• Curiosity, open to extend activity scope

• Agile and innovative mindset

• Business / financial acumen

• Strong communication, team and influencing skills (lead without being formally in charge)

• Result oriented

• Resilience and perseverance

Education / Qualification

• Bachelor or Master degree in engineering, preferably in Chemical Process Engineering or equivalent technical masters degree

• Additional business certificate is a plus

Language Requirements

• Fluency in English (oral and written)

• Any other language is a plus

Mobility requirements

• Up to 30% travelling internationally

Benefits

• Hybrid work contract

• Family Support: Subsidized childcare and paid maternity/paternity leave

• Professional Growth: Company-sponsored training and professional development.

• Discounts and Perks: Subsidized meals, exclusive discounts, and company gifts for special occasions.

• Long-service awards

• Employee referral bonus

• Pension and Savings: Access to a comprehensive pension fund and an employee savings scheme.

Holcim is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We support equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of race, national origin, gender, sexuality, disability, or age.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Panoramica del ruolo

Holcim ha annunciato nel 2025 la strategia NextGen Growth 2030 con la visione di essere il partner leader per la costruzione sostenibile e la creazione di valore superiore per persone, clienti e azionisti. I principali quattro pilastri della strategia sono gli investimenti mirati in mercati attraenti, la sostenibilità che guida la crescita redditizia, l'espansione di soluzioni costruttive ad alto valore, nonché una cultura delle prestazioni e la creazione di valore. Parte degli obiettivi di sostenibilità sono volumi triplicanti di base di materiali riciclati 2024 (20+Mt di materiale di demolizione delle costruzioni), riducendo le emissioni di portata inferiori a 400 kg/t cementizio e riducendo il 33% del prelievo di acqua dolce. Dobbiamo sviluppare ulteriormente varie tecnologie con

l'obiettivo di avere 2030 soluzioni economicamente realizzabili a livello industriale e di produrre prodotti a basso/no CO2. In ordine

sviluppare e gestire tecnologie dirompenti e dare il miglior supporto ai paesi nell'integrazione di nuove tecnologie

l'ambiente di produzione del cemento, le attività tecniche devono essere coordinate tra i vari attori.

Principali responsabilità

• Sviluppare o esplorare idee e concetti dirompenti nel campo della produzione di cemento con un focus sulle tecnologie di processo termico, la combustione e la gestione dell'energia; principalmente l'innovazione aperta, lo sviluppo parzialmente proprio.

• Progettare processi termici da idee tramite test di laboratorio per commissionare con successo i dimostranti

• Sviluppare, implementare e guidare test, prototipi e impianti pilota insieme alle aziende di Gruppo

• Coordinamento di varie parti interessate e partner a livello globale nel campo dei progetti di innovazione di processo, interni ed esterni (accademia, fornitori ecc.) assicurando inoltre l'interfaccia ai processi a monte e a valle

• Sviluppare conoscenze future per il gruppo Holcim

• Coaching e potenziare i team di progetto nei paesi e nelle regioni al fine di guidare l'innovazione di processo all'interno dei loro progetti o studi.

• Rappresentare il team Process Innovation in diversi progetti Holcim, in incontri e/o conferenze, condividere, diffondere conoscenze e best practice

Profilo richiesto

1 - Capacità tecniche / funzionali:

• La leadership tecnica nelle tecnologie di combustione tradizionali e alternative, la comprensione delle fasi di clinker mineralogico è un bene

• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti multiculturali e multidisciplinari

• L'esperienza in un ambiente di innovazione è un bene

2 - Leadership e capacità manageriali:

• Leader per i risultati senza essere responsabile

• Sfidare lo status quo

• Orientamento del team

• L'orientamento delle prestazioni

3 - Competenze comportamentali:

• Curiosità, aperta a estendere la portata di attività

• Mindset aggressivo e innovativo

• Affari / acume finanziario

• Forte comunicazione, team e competenze di influenza (percorso senza essere formalmente responsabile)

• Risultato orientato

• Resilienza e perseveranza

Istruzione / Qualificazione

• Laurea o Master in ingegneria, preferibilmente in Ingegneria dei processi chimici o equivalente master tecnici

• Certificato di business aggiuntivo è un plus

Requisiti linguistici

• Fluenza in inglese (orale e scritta)

• Qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus

Requisiti di mobilità

• Fino al 30% di viaggio a livello internazionale

Vantaggi

• Contratto di lavoro ibrido

• Supporto familiare: assistenza all'infanzia subsidizzata e congedo di maternità/paternità pagato

• Crescita professionale: formazione aziendale e sviluppo professionale.

• Sconti e vantaggi: pasti sottosidrati, sconti esclusivi e regali aziendali per occasioni speciali.

• Premi a lungo termine

• Bonus di riferimento per i dipendenti

• Pensione e risparmio: accesso a un fondo pensione completo e un sistema di risparmio dei dipendenti.

Holcim si impegna in un luogo di lavoro vario e inclusivo. Supportiamo pari opportunità per tutti, indipendentemente dalla razza, origine nazionale, genere, sessualità, disabilità, o età.

jobs.title: Head of Ready to Operate CCUS

titleByLocale.en: Head of Ready to Operate CCUS

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Head of Ready to Operate will be responsible for developing and training the Operations and Maintenance organization to safely and sustainably run the future CO2 value chain in combination with the existing cement facilities. S(He) will develop structures for the future Operations and Maintenance organization, ensure SOPs and procedures are in place, ensure tools and training are defined and provided for operating and maintaining the facilities. (S)He ensures operations management and maintenance management systems are in place and uploaded with the required data. (S)He will also integrate the Plant of the Future requirements and define the minimum requirements for the CO2 value chain.

The role will lead a transformation in Operations and Maintenance thinking as the cement operations with a CO2 value chain will impose different trade-offs to maximize revenue than currently prevail in cement production.

As part of the readiness for operations:

•
 (S)He will also set up the commissioning structure and teams.

•
 (S)He will support the CCUS teams to integrate this strategy in the country’s CCUS project.

•
 (S)He will be responsible for the cost effective implementation

•
 (S)He will be the design authority for Operation and Maintenance for CCUS projects

•
 (S)He will be contributing to the evaluation and promotion plant of the future application and use of digital tools

•
 (S)He will be involved in developing contracts for Operation and Maintenance support for the new Assets, and setting performance criteria for vendors

•
 (S)He will ensure that pre-start-up safety reviews (PSSR), are conducted with HAZID, HAZOP, SIL audits closed out, and critical safety interlocks are end-to-end tested prior to energization.

•
 (S)He validates the Certification for the Start-up of Operations (RFSU) and provisional acceptance tests.

•
 (S)He ensures reporting structures and systems are in place to demonstrate compliance with environmental permitting requirements

Main responsibilities

•
 Defining the future Operations and Maintenance requirements across the entire CO2 value chain in addition to the cement plant operation

•
 Manage and structure the preparation of future Operations requirements

•
 Manage and structure the preparation of future Maintenance requirements

•
 Design future Operations and Maintenance organizations both corporately and in country

•
 Develop the ready to operate organization in CCUS-CAPEX

•
 Develop the minimum design requirements/criteria for CCUS projects from an Operations and Maintenance perspective

•
 Coach the country Operations and Maintenance team to be ready to operate the new facilities and CO2 value chain sustainably with a high uptime and minimum cost

•
 Set up structures to realize flawless commissioning and start-up of the new facilities

•
 Define structure for continuous improvement (key KPI’s) to capture lessons learned and best practices

•
 Develop training programs for the project Operations and Maintenance staff including Operator Training Simulator.

•
 Develop the Holcim CCUS academy

Profile required

1 - Specific work experience:

•
 At least 5-10 years of Operations and Maintenance experience ideally in gas plants, Cement plant experience is an added advantage

•
 Experience in an Operating and Maintenance Management role (i.e. Plant Manager)

2 - Technical / functional skills:

•
 Good understanding of KPI’s and impact on EBITA

•
 Deep knowledge of Operations and Maintenance requirements

•
 Deep understanding of gas processing facilities, Process safety, pressurized equipment, cryogenic equipment, and rotating equipment, and industrial maintenance strategies

3 - Behavioural competencies:

•
 Forward thinking and ability to imagine the new business/operations environment

•
 Ability to motivate people and to convince

•
 Ability to coach staff to embark on the transformation journey

•
 Building relationships with multiple stakeholders

•
 Systemic and project wise managing the delivery of all operations and maintenance requirements

•
 Communication ability in a multi-cultural environment.

•
 Ability to work under pressure and in a matrix organization with team located in several locations

•
 Open minded for innovation and change.

•
 Team player and committed to ethics and group values

•
 Open to diversity and good communication verbal and written

•
 Self-starting and innovative

•
 Optimal self-controlled

•
 Guiding and developing others

•
 Team work oriented

•
 Strong analytical skills, high sense of priorities and decision making ability

4 - Leadership and managerial abilities:

•
 Leadership by influencing

•
 Leadership and technical decision skills for a complex industrial project in an uncertain world

•
 Capacity to forecast, analyze and mitigate technical risks

•
 Managerial and communication skills

•
 Reporting timely and accurately

•
 Communication and negotiating ability within Holcim and with external third parties.

Education / Qualification

•
 BSc. MSc. in a technical discipline

•
 Ideally 15 year experience in a plant / industrial environment

Language Requirements

•
 Fluency in English (oral and written)

•
 Any other language is a plus

Benefits

•
 Hybrid work contract

•
 Family Support: Subsidized childcare and paid maternity/paternity leave

•

•
 Discounts and Perks: Subsidized meals, exclusive discounts, and company gifts for special occasions.

S(He) svilupperà strutture per la futura organizzazione Operazioni e Manutenzione, assicurerà che le SOP e le procedure siano in vigore, assicurino che gli strumenti e la formazione siano definiti e previsti per il funzionamento e il mantenimento delle strutture. (S) garantisce la gestione delle operazioni e sistemi di gestione della manutenzione sono in vigore e caricati con i dati richiesti. (S)Incorporerà anche la Pianta del Futuro e definirà i requisiti minimi per la catena del valore di CO2.

Il ruolo porterà una trasformazione in Operazioni e Manutenzione pensando che le operazioni di cemento con una catena di valore CO2 imporranno diversi trade-off per massimizzare i ricavi che attualmente prevalgono nella produzione di cemento.

Come parte della disponibilità per le operazioni:

(S)Ha anche istituito la struttura di messa in servizio e le squadre.

(S) convalida la certificazione per l'avvio delle operazioni (RFSU) e i test di accettazione provvisori.

(S) Assicura che le strutture di reportistica e i sistemi siano in atto per dimostrare la conformità ai requisiti di tutela ambientale

Principali responsabilità

Definizione dei futuri requisiti Operazioni e Manutenzione in tutta la catena di valore CO2 oltre al funzionamento dell'impianto di cemento

Progettazione futuro Operazioni e Manutenzione organizzazioni sia corporatemente che in paese

descriptionByLocale.en:
Role Overview

The Head of Ready to Operate will be responsible for developing and training the Operations and Maintenance organization to safely and sustainably run the future CO2 value chain in combination with the existing cement facilities. S(He) will develop structures for the future Operations and Maintenance organization, ensure SOPs and procedures are in place, ensure tools and training are defined and provided for operating and maintaining the facilities. (S)He ensures operations management and maintenance management systems are in place and uploaded with the required data. (S)He will also integrate the Plant of the Future requirements and define the minimum requirements for the CO2 value chain.

The role will lead a transformation in Operations and Maintenance thinking as the cement operations with a CO2 value chain will impose different trade-offs to maximize revenue than currently prevail in cement production.

As part of the readiness for operations:

•
(S)He will also set up the commissioning structure and teams.

•
(S)He will support the CCUS teams to integrate this strategy in the country’s CCUS project.

•
(S)He will be responsible for the cost effective implementation

•
(S)He will be the design authority for Operation and Maintenance for CCUS projects

•
(S)He will be contributing to the evaluation and promotion plant of the future application and use of digital tools

•
(S)He will be involved in developing contracts for Operation and Maintenance support for the new Assets, and setting performance criteria for vendors

•
(S)He will ensure that pre-start-up safety reviews (PSSR), are conducted with HAZID, HAZOP, SIL audits closed out, and critical safety interlocks are end-to-end tested prior to energization.

•
(S)He validates the Certification for the Start-up of Operations (RFSU) and provisional acceptance tests.

•
(S)He ensures reporting structures and systems are in place to demonstrate compliance with environmental permitting requirements

Main responsibilities

•
Defining the future Operations and Maintenance requirements across the entire CO2 value chain in addition to the cement plant operation

•
Manage and structure the preparation of future Operations requirements

•
Manage and structure the preparation of future Maintenance requirements

•
Design future Operations and Maintenance organizations both corporately and in country

•
Develop the ready to operate organization in CCUS-CAPEX

•
Develop the minimum design requirements/criteria for CCUS projects from an Operations and Maintenance perspective

•
Coach the country Operations and Maintenance team to be ready to operate the new facilities and CO2 value chain sustainably with a high uptime and minimum cost

•
Set up structures to realize flawless commissioning and start-up of the new facilities

•
Define structure for continuous improvement (key KPI’s) to capture lessons learned and best practices

•
Develop training programs for the project Operations and Maintenance staff including Operator Training Simulator.

•
Develop the Holcim CCUS academy

Profile required

1 - Specific work experience:

•
At least 5-10 years of Operations and Maintenance experience ideally in gas plants, Cement plant experience is an added advantage

•
Experience in an Operating and Maintenance Management role (i.e. Plant Manager)

2 - Technical / functional skills:

•
Good understanding of KPI’s and impact on EBITA

•
Deep knowledge of Operations and Maintenance requirements

•
Deep understanding of gas processing facilities, Process safety, pressurized equipment, cryogenic equipment, and rotating equipment, and industrial maintenance strategies

3 - Behavioural competencies:

•
Forward thinking and ability to imagine the new business/operations environment

•
Ability to motivate people and to convince

•
Ability to coach staff to embark on the transformation journey

•
Building relationships with multiple stakeholders

•
Systemic and project wise managing the delivery of all operations and maintenance requirements

•
Communication ability in a multi-cultural environment.

•
Ability to work under pressure and in a matrix organization with team located in several locations

•
Open minded for innovation and change.

•
Team player and committed to ethics and group values

•
Open to diversity and good communication verbal and written

•
Self-starting and innovative

•
Optimal self-controlled

•
Guiding and developing others

•
Team work oriented

•
Strong analytical skills, high sense of priorities and decision making ability

4 - Leadership and managerial abilities:

•
Leadership by influencing

•
Leadership and technical decision skills for a complex industrial project in an uncertain world

•
Capacity to forecast, analyze and mitigate technical risks

•
Managerial and communication skills

•
Reporting timely and accurately

•
Communication and negotiating ability within Holcim and with external third parties.

Education / Qualification

•
BSc. MSc. in a technical discipline

•
Ideally 15 year experience in a plant / industrial environment

Language Requirements

•
Fluency in English (oral and written)

•
Any other language is a plus

Benefits

•
Hybrid work contract

•
Family Support: Subsidized childcare and paid maternity/paternity leave

•
Professional Growth: Company-sponsored training and professional development.

•
Discounts and Perks: Subsidized meals, exclusive discounts, and company gifts for special occasions.

•
Long-service awards

•
Employee referral bonus

•
Pension and Savings: Access to a comprehensive pension fund and an employee savings scheme.

Rollenübersicht

Der Head of Ready to Operate wird für die Entwicklung und Schulung der Betriebs- und Instandhaltungsorganisation verantwortlich sein, um die zukünftige CO2-Wertschöpfungskette in Kombination mit den bestehenden Zementanlagen sicher und nachhaltig zu betreiben. S(He) wird Strukturen für die zukünftige Betriebs- und Wartungsorganisation entwickeln, sicherstellen, dass SOPs und Verfahren vorhanden sind, sicherstellen, dass Werkzeuge und Schulungen für den Betrieb und die Wartung der Einrichtungen definiert und bereitgestellt werden. (S)Er stellt sicher, dass Betriebsmanagement- und Wartungsmanagementsysteme vorhanden sind und mit den erforderlichen Daten hochgeladen werden. (S)Er wird auch die Anforderungen von Plant of the Future integrieren und die Mindestanforderungen für die CO2-Wertschöpfungskette definieren.

Die Rolle wird eine Transformation im Operations and Maintenance-Denken anführen, da die Zementbetriebe mit einer CO2-Wertschöpfungskette unterschiedliche Kompromisse zur Maximierung des Umsatzes darstellen werden, als sie derzeit in der Zementproduktion vorherrschen.

Im Rahmen der Einsatzbereitschaft:

•
(S)Er wird auch die Kommissionierungsstruktur und die Teams einrichten.

•
(S)Er wird die CCUS-Teams dabei unterstützen, diese Strategie in das CCUS-Projekt des Landes zu integrieren.

•
(S)Er wird für die kosteneffektive Umsetzung verantwortlich sein

•
(S)Er wird die Konstruktionsbehörde für Betrieb und Wartung für CCUS-Projekte sein

•
(S)Er wird einen Beitrag zur Bewertung und Förderung der zukünftigen Anwendung und Nutzung digitaler Tools leisten

•
(S)Er wird an der Entwicklung von Verträgen für die Betriebs- und Wartungsunterstützung für die neuen Assets beteiligt sein und Leistungskriterien für Anbieter festlegen.

•
(S) Er wird sicherstellen, dass Sicherheitsüberprüfungen vor dem Start (PSSR) durchgeführt werden, wobei HAZID-, HAZOP- und SIL-Audits abgeschlossen sind und kritische Sicherheitsverriegelungen vor der Aktivierung durchgängig getestet werden.

•
(S)Er validiert die Zertifizierung für den Start-up of Operations (RFSU) und vorläufige Akzeptanztests.

•
(S)Er stellt sicher, dass Berichtsstrukturen und -systeme vorhanden sind, um die Einhaltung der Umweltgenehmigungsanforderungen nachzuweisen

Hauptzuständigkeiten

•
Festlegung der künftigen Betriebs- und Instandhaltungsanforderungen über die gesamte CO2-Wertschöpfungskette zusätzlich zum Zementanlagenbetrieb

Verwalten und strukturieren Sie die Vorbereitung zukünftiger Betriebsanforderungen

Verwalten und strukturieren Sie die Vorbereitung zukünftiger Wartungsanforderungen

Konzipieren Sie zukünftige Betriebs- und Wartungsorganisationen sowohl unternehmensweit als auch im Land

Entwicklung der betriebsbereiten Organisation in CCUS-CAPEX

Coach des Landes Operations and Maintenance-Teams, um bereit zu sein, die neuen Anlagen und die CO2-Wertschöpfungskette nachhaltig mit hoher Verfügbarkeit und minimalen Kosten zu betreiben

Aufbau von Strukturen zur Realisierung einer einwandfreien Inbetriebnahme und Inbetriebnahme der neuen Anlagen

Entwicklung von Schulungsprogrammen für das Betriebs- und Wartungspersonal des Projekts, einschließlich des Simulators für das Bedienpersonal.

Aperçu du rôle

Le responsable de Ready to Operate sera chargé de développer et de former l'organisation des opérations et de l'entretien afin de gérer de façon sûre et durable la future chaîne de valeur du CO2 en combinaison avec les installations de ciment existantes. S(He) élaborera des structures pour la future organisation des opérations et de l'entretien, veillera à ce que les SOP et les procédures soient en place, veillera à ce que les outils et la formation soient définis et fournis pour l'exploitation et l'entretien des installations. (S)Il s'assure que les systèmes de gestion des opérations et de maintenance sont en place et téléchargés avec les données requises. (S)Il intégrera également les exigences de l'usine du futur et définira les exigences minimales pour la chaîne de valeur du CO2.

Ce rôle mènera à une transformation de la pensée des opérations et de l'entretien, car les opérations de ciment à chaîne de valeur du CO2 imposeront des compromis différents pour maximiser les revenus par rapport à ce qui prévaut actuellement dans la production de ciment.

Dans le cadre de la préparation aux opérations:

•
(S)Il mettra également en place la structure de mise en service et les équipes.

•
(S)Il soutiendra les équipes du CCUS pour intégrer cette stratégie dans le projet du CCUS.

•
(S)Il sera responsable de la mise en œuvre rentable

•
(S)Il sera l'autorité de conception pour le fonctionnement et l'entretien des projets CCUS

•
(S)Il contribuera à l'évaluation et à la promotion de la future application et utilisation des outils numériques

•
(S)Il participera à l'élaboration de contrats d'appui aux opérations et à l'entretien des nouveaux biens et à l'établissement de critères de performance pour les fournisseurs

•
(S)Il s'assurera que les examens de sécurité prédémarrage (PSSR) sont effectués avec les vérifications HAZID, HAZOP, SIL terminées, et que les dispositifs de verrouillage de sécurité critiques sont testés de bout en bout avant l'énergisation.

•
(S)Il valide la certification pour le démarrage des opérations (RFSU) et les tests d'acceptation provisoires.

•
(S)Il s'assure que des structures et des systèmes de déclaration sont en place pour démontrer la conformité aux exigences en matière de permis environnementaux

Principales responsabilités

•
Définition des besoins futurs en matière d'exploitation et d'entretien pour toute la chaîne de valeur du CO2 en plus de l'exploitation de la cimenterie

•
Gérer et structurer la préparation des besoins opérationnels futurs

•
Gérer et structurer la préparation des besoins futurs en matière de maintenance

•
Concevoir de futures organisations d'exploitation et d'entretien, tant au niveau de l'entreprise qu'au niveau national

•
Développer l'organisation prête à fonctionner dans CCUS-CAPEX

•
Élaborer les exigences/critères minimaux de conception pour les projets du CCUS dans une perspective d'exploitation et de maintenance

•
Entraîner l'équipe d'exploitation et d'entretien du pays à être prête à exploiter de façon durable les nouvelles installations et la chaîne de valeur du CO2 avec un temps de disponibilité élevé et un coût minimum

•
Mettre en place des structures pour réaliser la mise en service et le démarrage impeccables des nouvelles installations

•
Définir une structure pour l'amélioration continue (KPI) afin de saisir les enseignements tirés et les meilleures pratiques

Élaborer des programmes de formation pour le personnel d'exploitation et d'entretien du projet, y compris le simulateur de formation des exploitants.

•
Développer l'académie de Holcim CCUS

1 - Expérience professionnelle spécifique:

Au moins 5-10 ans d'expérience d'exploitation et d'entretien idéalement dans les usines de gaz, l'expérience d'usine de ciment est un avantage supplémentaire
